the convolutional neural network with spectrogram input achieves the best performance for singing voice detection, with an accuracy of 91.8%.
the CNN model with spectrograms as input yields the best performance, followed by the CNN model with MFCCs as input.
the convolutional neural network with spectrogram input is the best model for singing voice detection, and the voting ensemble method is the most effective ensemble learning method.

a CNN with spectrogram as input is the most accurate method, and voting with five models yields the highest accuracy with the lowest computational cost.
